objective: Install mise and the toolchain mise.toml pins (including the canary Bun that provides bun check, bun lint and bun fmt) in this container, so `mise run verify` and the lefthook pre-commit hook can run.
scope: Repository: /home/user/holyagent. mise.toml is the source of commands and tools; the lefthook pre-commit hook calls `mise` and fails today with `sh: 1: mise: not found`. Bun 1.4.4 stable is installed; the repository needs the canary Bun mise.toml selects.

Install mise for the root user in a standard location on PATH for later shells (for example ~/.local/bin, with the activation the mise docs give for bash/sh), trust the project config (`mise trust`), and `mise install` the pinned tools. Installs outside the repository (home directory, tool caches) are expected; inside the repository only node_modules may change (if dependencies must be installed). Outbound HTTPS goes through a proxy; read /root/.ccr/README.md if TLS or downloads fail (use the CA bundle /root/.ccr/ca-bundle.crt, never disable verification).
Then run `mise run verify` once and report its outcome verbatim in summary (failures included; other writers are mid-change, so failures in their areas are expected and are not yours to fix).
A non-interactive shell started later by another tool call must find `mise` (check with a fresh `sh -c 'command -v mise'` and `bash -lc 'command -v mise'`).
constraints: Change no tracked repository file; do not commit, branch, push or edit .git/ or .holyagent/.
Do not fix test or lint failures; report them.
Stop and report if a download is denied by the proxy (403/407); do not work around it.
